# Puter API Bridge

## Project Overview
An OpenAI-compatible API bridge that converts the Puter.js SDK into a free, unlimited API server. Supports models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more via the Puter platform.

## Key Files
- `src/server.js` - Express server with `/v1/chat/completions` (streaming + non-streaming) and `/v1/models` endpoints
- `src/cli.js` - Commander-based CLI with `start`, `stop`, `status`, `logs` commands, supports daemonization
- `src/stop.js` - Simple stop script for PID-based shutdown

## Commands
- `puter-api start` - Start as background daemon
- `puter-api stop` - Stop the daemon
- `puter-api status` - Check if running
- `puter-api logs` - View logs (with -f for follow)
- `npm start` - Run in foreground
- `npm install -g .` - Install globally from local repo

## Architecture
- `PUTER_API_KEY` env var for optional auth
- `PUTER_API_PORT` (default: 8741) and `PUTER_API_HOST` (default: 127.0.0.1)
- `PUTER_API_DEFAULT_MODEL` (default: gpt-4o)
- Models are dynamically fetched from Puter SDK (`puter.ai.listModels()`) with hardcoded alias fallback
- PID file at `.puter-api.pid`, logs at `puter-api.log`
